name: Iori
source:
Age: Appears as 15
Specialization: Enchantment
Main Element: Wind
Secondary Element: Fire
History: She come in Astral around the same time as Lumen. Iori befriended Lumen
very soon after Lumen come into astral and has been her best friend since then. She is average in witchcraft.
Personality: Cheerful, easygoing, friendly and tomboyish. She likes to be in groups and have fun. At first look
it doesn't seem like there is much to be said about her, but she cares about her friends more than she lets on
and isn't as simpleminded as she appears.
